name: Howard Yawit
abstract_title: Radiofrequency S-Parameter Signatures of Tardigrades and Algae Microcosms
abstract: Tardigrades are microscopic multicellular extremophiles that can survive severe environmental stress by entering highly robust survival states. Their ability to maintain organized structure and reversible viability under such conditions makes them a useful model for examining how physical and biological organization appear in the electromagnetic response of living systems.
